add-attachment-to-password-protected-pdf.title: Add Attachment to Password-Protected PDF
add-attachment-to-password-protected-pdf.description: Shows how to open an encrypted PDF with a user password, embed a file as an attachment, and save the PDF while keeping its protection intact.

add-attachment-to-pdf-and-save.title: Add Attachment To Pdf And Save

add-custom-descriptions-to-pdf-attachmen.title: Add Custom Descriptions To Pdf Attachments

add-file-attachment-to-pdf-with-error-ha.title: Add File Attachment to PDF with Error Handling
add-file-attachment-to-pdf-with-error-ha.description: Demonstrates how to attach a file to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf and includes robust error handling for missing source or attachment files.

add-file-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add File Attachment to PDF
add-file-attachment-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load an existing PDF, create a FileSpecification for a file, attach it to a page using a FileAttachmentAnnotation, and save the updated document.

add-file-attachment-with-retry.title: Add File Attachment to PDF with Retry Logic
add-file-attachment-with-retry.description: Shows how to attach a file to the first page of a PDF located on a network share using Aspose.Pdf, with retry handling for transient I/O errors.

add-image-watermark-to-pdf-attachments.title: Add Image Watermark to PDF Attachments
add-image-watermark-to-pdf-attachments.description: Shows how to iterate through embedded PDF attachments, apply an image watermark to every page of each attachment, and replace the original attachment with the watermarked version before saving the main document.

add-image-watermark-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Image Watermark To Pdf Pages

add-in-memory-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add In-Memory Attachment to PDF
add-in-memory-attachment-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file stored in a MemoryStream as an attachment in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, and save the result without creating intermediate files on disk.

add-multiple-attachments-to-pdf.title: Add Multiple Attachments to a PDF
add-multiple-attachments-to-pdf.description: Shows how to embed several files into an existing PDF by iterating a list of file paths and saving the updated document.

add-multiple-files-to-pdf-portfolio.title: Add Multiple Files to a PDF Portfolio
add-multiple-files-to-pdf-portfolio.description: Demonstrates how to embed several files of different formats into a single PDF portfolio using Aspose.Pdf in one loop.

add-nested-pdf-to-pdf-portfolio.title: Add Nested PDF to Existing PDF Portfolio
add-nested-pdf-to-pdf-portfolio.description: Demonstrates how to embed a PDF file as a nested item inside an existing PDF portfolio using Aspose.Pdf.

add-unicode-file-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add Unicode File Attachment to PDF
add-unicode-file-attachment-to-pdf.description: Shows how to embed a file with a Unicode (e.g., Chinese) filename into a PDF as a file‑attachment annotation using Aspose.Pdf.

add-word-document-to-pdf-portfolio.title: Add Word Document to PDF Portfolio
add-word-document-to-pdf-portfolio.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF portfolio and embed a Word (.docx) file using Aspose.Pdf's Collection and FileSpecification classes.

apply-custom-visual-template-to-pdf-port.title: Apply Custom Visual Template to PDF Portfolio
apply-custom-visual-template-to-pdf-port.description: Shows how to load a PDF Portfolio and apply a visual template to each page by adding a semi‑transparent background rectangle and header text using Aspose.Pdf.Drawing and Aspose.Pdf.Text classes.

apply-visual-template-to-pdf-portfolio.title: Apply Visual Template To Pdf Portfolio

attach-file-from-byte-array-to-pdf.title: Attach a File from a Byte Array to a PDF
attach-file-from-byte-array-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a FileSpecification from a byte array using a MemoryStream and add it as a file attachment annotation to an existing PDF document.

attach-remote-file-to-pdf.title: Attach Remote File to PDF
attach-remote-file-to-pdf.description: Downloads a file from a remote URL into memory and adds it as a file attachment annotation to an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-add-attachment-to-pdfs.title: Batch Add Attachment to PDFs
batch-add-attachment-to-pdfs.description: Shows how to iterate through a folder of PDF files, attach the same external file to each document, and save the modified PDFs to an output directory using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-extract-pdf-attachments-to-zip.title: Batch Extract PDF Attachments to a ZIP Archive
batch-extract-pdf-attachments-to-zip.description: Shows how to iterate over multiple PDF files, retrieve their embedded attachments with Aspose.Pdf, and consolidate all attachments into a single ZIP archive.

compress-pdf-portfolio-with-optimization.title: Compress PDF Portfolio and Save with Optimization
compress-pdf-portfolio-with-optimization.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF Portfolio, enable object compression using OptimizationOptions, and save the compressed portfolio to a new file.

convert-pdf-to-portfolio-with-embedded-f.title: Convert Pdf To Portfolio With Embedded Files

create-pdf-portfolio-embed-files.title: Create PDF Portfolio by Embedding Files
create-pdf-portfolio-embed-files.description: Demonstrates how to convert an existing PDF into a PDF Portfolio by adding multiple embedded files using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-portfolio-with-attachments.title: Create PDF Portfolio with Attachments
create-pdf-portfolio-with-attachments.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF portfolio document and embed files as attachments using Aspose.Pdf's Document, Collection, and FileSpecification classes.

create-pdf-portfolio-with-multiple-embed.title: Create Pdf Portfolio With Multiple Embedded Files

delete-outline-items-by-text.title: Delete PDF Outline Items by Matching Text
delete-outline-items-by-text.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, searching its outline (bookmark) entries for a specific text, and removing the matching items using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-pdf-attachment-by-filename.title: Delete PDF Attachment by Filename using Aspose.Pdf
delete-pdf-attachment-by-filename.description: Demonstrates how to locate and remove an embedded file from a PDF by matching its filename with Aspose.Pdf.

delete-pdf-outline-items-matching-text.title: Delete Pdf Outline Items Matching Text

embed-attachment-metadata-into-pdf.title: Embed Attachment Metadata into PDF Information Dictionary
embed-attachment-metadata-into-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, adds an embedded file, stores custom attachment metadata in the document information dictionary, and transfers that info into the PDF metadata using conversion options.

embed-hidden-xml-metadata-pdf-attachment.title: Embed Hidden XML Metadata as PDF Attachment
embed-hidden-xml-metadata-pdf-attachment.description: Serializes a custom metadata object to XML, embeds it in a PDF as a hidden file attachment annotation, and saves the modified document.

embed-image-into-pdf-portfolio.title: Embed Image into PDF Portfolio with Display Name
embed-image-into-pdf-portfolio.description: Demonstrates how to embed an image file into a PDF portfolio using Aspose.Pdf and set a custom display name for the embedded file.

extract-attachment-by-name-from-pdf.title: Extract Attachment By Name From Pdf

extract-attachments-from-encrypted-pdf.title: Extract Attachments from Encrypted PDF
extract-attachments-from-encrypted-pdf.description: Shows how to open a password‑protected PDF, decrypt it, and extract all embedded file attachments to a specified folder.

extract-embedded-file-from-pdf-portfolio.title: Extract Embedded File from PDF Portfolio by Index
extract-embedded-file-from-pdf-portfolio.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF containing a portfolio, retrieve an embedded file by its 1‑based index, and save it using the original file name and extension.

extract-embedded-files-from-pdf-portfoli.title: Extract Embedded Files from PDF Portfolio
extract-embedded-files-from-pdf-portfoli.description: The example opens a PDF portfolio, iterates through its embedded files, and saves each file to a local directory while preserving the virtual folder hierarchy.

extract-pdf-attachment-metadata.title: Extract PDF Attachment Metadata to JSON
extract-pdf-attachment-metadata.description: Shows how to read file‑attachment annotations from a PDF, obtain each attachment's file name and creation date, and write the collected metadata to a JSON file.

extract-pdf-attachments-in-parallel.title: Extract PDF Attachments in Parallel
extract-pdf-attachments-in-parallel.description: Shows how to process multiple PDF files concurrently and extract all embedded attachments using Aspose.Pdf, employing reflection to save each attachment.

extract-pdf-attachments-sha256-hash.title: Extract PDF Attachments and Compute SHA-256 Hashes
extract-pdf-attachments-sha256-hash.description: Loads a PDF, enumerates its embedded file attachments, and calculates a SHA‑256 hash for each attachment to verify integrity.

extract-pdf-attachments-to-subfolders.title: Extract PDF Attachments to Separate Subfolders
extract-pdf-attachments-to-subfolders.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate over its embedded files and save each attachment into its own subfolder.

extract-specific-attachment-from-pdf.title: Extract Specific Attachment from PDF
extract-specific-attachment-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to locate an embedded file by name in a PDF document and save it to a specified directory using Aspose.Pdf.

flatten-pdf-portfolio.title: Flatten PDF Portfolio to Standard PDF
flatten-pdf-portfolio.description: Loads a PDF Portfolio, removes its interactive collection UI by flattening the document, and saves it as a regular PDF file.

generate-csv-report-of-pdf-attachments.title: Generate Csv Report Of Pdf Attachments

generate-csv-report-pdf-attachments.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, enumerating its embedded file attachments, extracting name, size, and description, and writing the data to a CSV file.

generate-pdf-page-thumbnails.title: Generate Thumbnails for PDF Pages

measure-pdf-attachment-performance.title: Measure Performance of Adding, Extracting, and Removing PDF Attachments
measure-pdf-attachment-performance.description: Demonstrates how to add a file attachment annotation, list existing attachments, and remove an attachment from a PDF while logging the time taken for each operation using Aspose.Pdf.

merge-pdf-portfolios-preserve-metadata.title: Merge Two PDF Portfolios Preserving Embedded File Metadata
merge-pdf-portfolios-preserve-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to combine two PDF portfolios into a single document while keeping all embedded files and their associated metadata intact.

read-pdf-metadata-attachment-count.title: Read PDF Metadata and Count Attachments
read-pdf-metadata-attachment-count.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract standard document metadata, count embedded file attachments, and generate a simple text report.

remove-embedded-file-from-pdf-portfolio.title: Remove Embedded File from PDF Portfolio by Index
remove-embedded-file-from-pdf-portfolio.description: Demonstrates how to delete a specific embedded file from a PDF portfolio using its 1‑based collection index and save the updated document.

remove-pdf-attachment-by-index.title: Remove PDF Attachment by Index
remove-pdf-attachment-by-index.description: Shows how to delete an embedded file from a PDF using its zero‑based index with Aspose.Pdf.

reorder-pdf-outline-items.title: Reorder PDF Outline (Bookmark) Items
reorder-pdf-outline-items.description: Loads a PDF, extracts its top‑level outline (bookmark) entries, changes their order, clears the existing outlines, and re‑adds them in the new sequence.

set-custom-description-for-pdf-attachmen.title: Set Custom Description for PDF Attachment Annotations
set-custom-description-for-pdf-attachmen.description: Shows how to load a PDF, iterate over its pages and annotations, find file attachment annotations, and assign custom subject and file description metadata before saving the document.

test-attachment-removal-updates-collecti.title: Test Attachment Removal Updates Collection Count
test-attachment-removal-updates-collecti.description: Shows integration tests that verify removing or clearing attachments correctly updates the Attachments collection count in a ThreadMessageResponse.

update-pdf-attachment-description.title: Update PDF Attachment Description
update-pdf-attachment-description.description: Demonstrates how to locate a file attachment annotation in a PDF, modify its description, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-attachment-mime-type-and-add-to.title: Validate Attachment MIME Type and Add to PDF
validate-attachment-mime-type-and-add-to.description: The example verifies that a file's MIME type matches its extension, then embeds the file as an attachment annotation in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-attachment-size-before-adding-t.title: Validate Attachment Size Before Adding to PDF
validate-attachment-size-before-adding-t.description: Shows how to check each file's size against a limit and attach only those that meet the criteria as file attachment annotations in a PDF document.

verify-pdf-size-increase-after-adding-fi.title: Verify PDF Size Increase After Adding File Attachment
verify-pdf-size-increase-after-adding-fi.description: Creates a PDF, adds a FileAttachmentAnnotation, saves the modified document, and uses an NUnit test to assert that the file size grows as expected.

verify-pdf-size-increases-with-attachmen.title: Verify Pdf Size Increases With Attachment
